[![MarkBarthold](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/c/c3/MarkBarthold.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/200?cb=20210610001129)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/c/c3/MarkBarthold.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20210610001129)
**Mark John Barthold** is a former Mattel employee who worked at Mattel from 1990 to 2014. He designed for Hot Wheels around the 1990s and 2000s; he was involved with the [Motorized X-V Racers](/wiki/Motorized_X-V_Racers) series of cars. He currently works as a Principal Designer for competing brand Spin Master, and owns his own design company, Inventor 8.
